claims.statement: Pinned overview spans FPT/GHEC/GHES and organization/user Projects with Table/Board/Roadmap. Platform tool is adaptable, not itself enforced methodology or adopted engineering standard.

Issue/PR references sync bidirectionally and assignee changes/group dragging can alter underlying issue. Source automatic-sync statement provides no latency, stale-cache/concurrency, denied-write or complete-state guarantee.

Saved filtered/sorted/sliced/grouped views provide team perspectives, not separate data copies or permission boundaries. Unsaved view-private wording from detailed guide must not exempt actual repository field writes.

Custom types date/number/single-select/text/iteration are examples with 50 total fields including built-in metadata. Detailed issue-field scope and type-specific defaults/limits must qualify generalized capabilities.

Built-in/API/Actions automation capabilities are optional and distinct. Overview does not prove enabled workflows, historical backfill, exact permissions or effective event processing; detailed operation-specific semantics govern proposals.
Charts available to project viewers use added items; detailed insights excludes archived/deleted. Broad overview cannot establish lifetime denominator or independently accepted completion.

Organization templates include views/custom fields/drafts with values/workflows except auto-add/insights. Copy retains configuration intent, not identical access, immutable provenance, effective automation or rights clearance.

Project status/start/target/Markdown updates are high-level report and metadata, not independent acceptance evidence. Overview links to quickstart/best practices are separate unreviewed references at this tranche.

No configuration changed, upstream code executed, policy accepted, rights cleared or native behavior certified. All claims reference-only pending independent semantic/source-to-control and published assurance.
